moments.why: L'intervenant explique directement l'impact de la perturbation du détroit d'Ormuz sur le transit des engrais et la menace résultante sur la sécurité alimentaire.

moments.quote: was to develop a mechanism, focused on fertilizers and related raw materials such as urea, sulfur and ammonia, to prevent a massive humanitarian crisis... videos.title: Fertilizer crisis means food inflation 'locked in' for at least a year, says researcher

moments.quote: As the Strait of Hormuz blockage continues, it's not just oil and gas being impacted. Noah Gordon points out the supply and price of food and fertilizer is also impacted.
moments.why: Le présentateur explique dès les premières secondes de l'émission que le blocage du détroit d'Ormuz impacte l'approvisionnement et le prix des engrais et de la nourriture.

moments.quote: You've really got a double crisis with fertilizer. The Middle East region is a big producer of fertilizer itself, nitrogen-based fertilizer comes from places like Saudi Arabia and Qatar, and that obviously can't get out of the Strait just as oil and gas can't get out. And that's helped push fertilizer prices up about 40% in North America and more in some other regions.
moments.why: L'expert Noah Gordon explique la crise des engrais causée par l'impossibilité d'exporter depuis le détroit d'Ormuz, provoquant une hausse globale des prix.

videos.title: UN Warns Millions Risk Hunger as Hormuz Fertiliser Trade Remains Blocked | APT

moments.quote: The reason is clear: 1/3 of all seaborne fertilizers go through the Strait of Hormuz, and some of the poorest countries in Africa are highly dependent on fertilizers from the Strait of Hormuz. For instance, Sudan, Somalia, South Sudan, Kenya, Mozambique, but also in Southeast Asia, Sri Lanka is another example.
moments.why: L'intervenant explique directement que le passage des engrais par le détroit d'Ormuz est crucial pour l'approvisionnement agricole et la sécurité alimentaire de nombreux pays en développement.

moments.quote: When the crisis started, we knew that a few countries, some countries in Africa and Southeast Asia, would be impacted. Now it's much worse because the entire fertilizer market is disrupted.
moments.why: L'intervenant souligne la perturbation du marché des engrais liée au détroit et la menace directe que cela fait peser sur la production agricole et la sécurité alimentaire mondiale.

videos.title: Hormuz Blockade: How the Iran Conflict Threatens Global Food Supply and Fertilizer Markets

moments.quote: And fully a third of all fertilizers traded by sea usually pass through the Strait of Hormuz.
moments.why: La journaliste explique que le détroit d'Ormuz est un point de passage clé pour un tiers des engrais maritimes, menaçant la production alimentaire mondiale si le passage est bloqué.

moments.quote: The closure of the Strait of Hormuz will impact the world's access to fertilizer, right? Which will increase the cost of fertilizer, which will increase the cost of food production. I mean, it will be across the board.
moments.why: Stephane Dujarric (porte-parole de l'ONU) explique la menace directe d'une fermeture du détroit sur l'accès aux engrais et l'augmentation consécutive des coûts de la production alimentaire mondiale.

moments.quote: I would say we also really need to look at food prices because you need energy to produce food and natural gas, for example, is often used to produce fertilizer. So there's potential here for a jump in food prices.
moments.why: Stefan Angrick détaille le lien entre les tensions sur l'énergie/engrais et la hausse probable des prix alimentaires mondiaux.
